title: lint: warn when a text field named like a currency, country or time zone code declares no valueDomain
body:
③ maintainer-directed task. Source: maintainer, 「同意」 (2026-11-19T05:46Z), accepting the analysis item "evals plus one warning-level lint", then 「立卡 p1」 (05:47Z). Both are in the project thread on #35328. Child of #35328, sibling of #35345.

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 套件里像 `country`、`currency_code`、`time_zone` 这样的字段，作者常常写成普通文本，忘了挂平台的标准值域。结果是「CN / China / 中国」都能存进去，跨套件也对不上。
- **要做：** `os lint` 加一条警告。字段名像币种、国家或时区代码，类型是 `text`，又没写 `valueDomain` 时，提示应该挂哪个值域。只警告，不报错。
- **你要做的：** 无，已裁。

## Business reason
- **Who benefits:** every metadata-app project. The managed suites come first, because their cross-suite key contracts (#35328: party key = country + credit code) only match when the country is an ISO code.
- **If not done:** each suite stores free-text countries and currencies. Every later match or ERP link then starts with data cleaning, the same story as `uom` in #35339.

## Current state (read)
- `Field.valueDomain` exists and is enforced on `text` fields. The vocabulary is `iana_time_zone`, `iso_4217_currency` and `iso_3166_alpha2` (`packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.zod.ts:96-100`). The type set is in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, around line 161. This was ruled 2026-09-02, option A on #14168.
- No lint rule reads field names against it (`packages/lint/src`: `valueDomain` appears only in one test file).
- Skills mention the domain once, for currency only (`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:168`). Teaching the other two is part of #35345.

## Scope
- One `os lint` rule at **warning** severity, with an entry in `rule-explanations.ts` and a fix sentence naming the domain to add.
- It fires when all three hold: the field `type` is `text`, no `valueDomain` is declared, and the field name (after the namespace prefix, case-insensitive) is in a small fixed word list.
  - `iso_4217_currency`: `currency`, `currency_code`.
  - `iso_3166_alpha2`: `country`, `country_code`.
  - `iana_time_zone`: `time_zone`, `timezone`, `tz`.
- Keep the word list in one place next to the value-domain vocabulary, so the catalog in #35345 and this rule never diverge.
- ⛔ Warning only. A false positive should never push an author to rename a correct field.
- ⛔ No object-name shadow warning (an app object like `*_attachment` or `*_exchange_rate`). That waits for an inventory of what hotcrm and hotsrm duplicated.

## Reader
The `area:build` lint seat: one PR with the rule, its explanation, tests (fires and does not fire, including a field that already declares the domain and a `select` field) and a changeset.

## Dedupe
- `valueDomain lint text field currency country` → 3 hits, all closed. They are #14168 (the field-level domain, which landed), #15162 and #22136, none of them a lint rule.
- No open card covers this.

## Grade
`area:build · Feature · maintainer-sourced, grade set by the maintainer (「立卡 p1」) · reach: no lint fires on a free-text country or currency field today (read, packages/lint/src) · evidence: read`
